_comment: Chapter 6 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F29, a choice: the old god's voice for the first time (listen: vengeance + 1, c6.listened; refuse: mercy + 1, c6.refused).

text.zh_TW: 鏡廳裡所有的鏡子都映出你——可是每一個你都在笑，而你沒有笑。一個很老很老的聲音在你腦子裡說：「神裔。回家吧。你的身體，本來就是為我做的。」
text.en: Every mirror in the hall shows you, but every one of you is smiling, and you are not. A very, very old voice speaks inside your head. "Godborn. Come home. Your body was made for me."

text.zh_TW: 聲音：「我是讓你不再失去任何人的力量。你的家，被燒過一次。你想讓它再被燒一次嗎？」你的手掌熱得發燙。
text.en: The voice: "I am the power that means you never lose anyone again. Your home burned once. Do you want it to burn again?" Your palms burn hot.

text.zh_TW: 鏡子裡的笑臉一個一個碎掉了。聲音輕輕地笑：「……我們會在星星那裡再見的。」
text.en: One by one the smiling faces in the mirrors shatter. The voice laughs softly. "...We will meet again at the Star."
